image.caption: Three comic panels in the New Mexico desert in 1883: a cowboy on a black horse rides along a dusty road past cacti, thinking to himself, and arrives at the wooden sign of the small town of Santa Roja, with a saloon behind it.
image.title: Un pueblo pequeño

image.caption: A comic page in warm daylight colours: a young woman with a shoulder bag hurries into a grand station entrance, thinking she must be quick; at the ticket window she asks for a ticket for the next train while a queue waits; on the train a conductor checks her ticket; outside she asks an older man where to find a taxi and he points left.
image.title: Un billete, por favor

image.caption: A comic page in an elegant clothes shop: a woman in glasses slips a shirt and then a jacket into her large bag while a grey-haired man watches; when he comes over and says «Disculpe, señora», she calmly holds up a coat and asks for a smaller size.
image.title: Comprar ropa

image.caption: A comic page in warm night tones: in a busy emergency call centre two uniformed dispatchers in headsets take calls; below, a young dispatcher answers while a frightened girl with a toy rabbit hides under her bed, whispering into her phone.
image.title: Operadora de emergencias

image.caption: A comic page in warm forest tones: in the first panel a hound, a saluki and a spaniel freeze among the trees, sensing someone; in the second two dogs run off while a third keeps watch; in the last a whole pack of dogs stands waiting on the forest path as the first two arrive.
image.title: Los perros callejeros

image.caption: A comic page: a teenage boy with a backpack walks past a café and a bookshop on a sunny street, thinking he must find work; a café owner turns him down, and in the bookshop a woman listens as he says he loves books.
image.title: Buscando trabajo

image.caption: A night-time comic page: a girl in pyjamas holding a toy rabbit meets a small alien in a spacesuit beside a crashed, smoking spaceship; they tell each other their names, and the alien, looking sad, says he feels very bad.
image.title: Conociendo a Zik

image.caption: A comic page set in a busy diner: a waitress takes an order from a teenage boy and girl, who choose a chocolate and a vanilla milkshake, a hamburger and spaghetti bolognese, then she brings their food to the table.
image.title: Pedir en el restaurante

image.caption: A black-and-white comic page: four worn-out men in a dark shelter talk about staying together to keep each other safe; one asks how they should do it, and another tells him to leave the details to him.
image.title: Mantenerse a salvo

image.caption: A night-time comic page in blue tones: a small girl sits up in bed and calls her mother, who comes in to comfort her; the other panels show a ghost in the wardrobe, under the desk, under the bed and behind the sofa.
image.title: En la habitación
